An '''unidentified starfighter''' was in use within the region of space known as the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]].

==Characteristics==
This compact [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] possessed a boxy fuselage reminiscent of the cockpit of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]],<ref name="Veekhoven">{{SW|url=news/offscreen-but-not-forgotten-mini-rigs-body-rigs-and-other-kenner-vehicles|text=Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles|int=Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles|nolive=1}}</ref> flanked by vertical panels on pylons. Like the AT-ST, it had a chin-mounted [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]].<ref name="LCatSoT" />

==History==
Starfighters of this type saw use within the Centrality around the time of the [[Battle of ThonBoka]].<ref name="LCatSoT">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]'' {{C|Cover only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This starfighter appeared on the [[:File:Starcave_of_ThonBoka_Cover.jpg|cover]] of the novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''. The book's text does not indicate whether these images represent the "[[Interceptor/Legends|interceptors]]" at [[Hosrel XI]], a member of the ramshackle [[Zero Squadron]] of the [[Renatasian Confederation]], or some other fighter.

This starship has frequently been conflated with the [[INT-4 Interceptor/Legends|INT-4 Interceptor]], a [[Mini-Rigs]] toy produced by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] in [[1982]]. [[Tim Veekhoven]]'s [[Star Wars Blog]] post ''[[Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles]]'', however, revealed that the ships in this cover illustration were based on Kenner's [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|Scout Walker]] cockpits rather than the INT-4.
